Aiset-Bek

Biography

Aiset-Bek is the Khadaganian officer to whom Kardaur brings Zak. He treats the prisoner as material for training his soldiers in Death Canyon. His threat to make Kardaur take Zak’s place if the captive dies too quickly shows that his cruelty also extends to his subordinates. [1]
